sources.full: Generic Wereraven (Human Form) for Foundry VTT

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: The wereraven can use its action to change between its human form, a raven-humanoid hybrid, and a raven. Its statistics remain the same except for size and form-specific movement. Worn or carried equipment does not transform, and it returns to human form when it dies.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: The wereraven can imitate simple sounds it has heard. A creature can recognize the imitation with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The wereraven regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. This regeneration does not function on the turn after it takes damage from a silvered weapon or a spell. It dies only if it starts its turn at 0 hit points and cannot regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: The wereraven makes two weapon attacks. One of these attacks can be made with its hand crossbow.

action.name: Beak (Raven or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage in raven form, or 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage in hybrid form. A humanoid hit by this attack must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or contract wereraven lycanthropy.

action.name: Shortsword (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.
